params.prompt:
Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: Lavender swept spiky head, narrow yellow eyes, broad red lips, dark neck band, lavender torso and yellow hands/feet. Small smoking accessory held near one hand, attached; no floating background splash. Copy the attached character exactly.

Exactly 32 separate complete drawings, regular 4-column by 8-row grid, read left-to-right/top-to-bottom. All 32 are the SAME single actor, including lying floor drawings. No opponents or partner drawn.
Row 1 INTRO: relaxed idle; determined head turn with fists rising; guarded confident stance; settle combat guard.
Row 2 SPECIAL A: plant both feet wide and lower both hands to the covered front of his pelvis; lean torso back slightly, hands held at the covered low pelvis; hold the comic pelvic-forward attack stance; ease stance slightly while hands remain low. Mouth closed in all four drawings.
Row 3 SPECIAL B: feet planted, both hands remain at the covered front of the low pelvis; comic pelvic-forward leaning-back stance; stronger final pelvic-forward stance; recover combat guard. No punching or palm thrusts. Mouth closed. Pelvis stays fully covered, no exposed anatomy. No fluid or effects; engine draws the yellow stream from the pelvis.
Row 4 CAST: both hands move DOWN to the fully covered low pelvis; knees bend and torso leans back slightly; pelvic-forward comic urination attack stance facing RIGHT, hands low at covered pelvis; hands lift back into guard. Mouth CLOSED throughout, no mouth attack. No visible genitals, no exposed anatomy. Do not draw fluid; the engine supplies a yellow stream from the pelvis.
Row 5 RECOIL: chest impact arch; head/torso lean back with arms still connected; bend knees to absorb; regain combat guard.
Row 6 DEFEAT START: staggering upright; knees buckle; dropping toward floor with bent elbows; roll onto side with head and feet fully visible.
Row 7 DEFEAT FLOOR: entirely lying on side, head to LEFT feet to RIGHT; same lying body settles; small final shoulder drop; side-lying completely still. No kneeling or standing in any of these four.
Row 8 DEFEAT REST: same side-lying floor silhouette with tiny relaxed hand change; same side-lying rest; same resting body; final completely relaxed side-lying body. Floor poses are lower than standing poses; never stretch them upright. All hats, heads, hands and feet remain connected and fully visible.
